name: Tropykus RSK
rootCause: Tropykus RSK's Rootstock-based lending protocol was exploited on 14 June 2023 for approximately $150,000 through a rounding error in share-redemption accounting, allowing an attacker to extract excess value. No primary transaction or code evidence is available. A receipt-share redemption calculation rounded down during withdrawal, enabling attackers to retain tiny residual shares with exaggerated value in an inflated low-liquidity market.
